visual_description: An angel form, wings forward, crouched in grief or wrath. Details burned in sacred static.
emotional_response: Sacrifice or rage. Hard to tell through the red.
rational_analysis: Celestial failure. Divinity’s refusal to ascend.
existential_reflection: Maybe Mizontresh *was* divine—once. But when it touched earth, it bent like this... toward mourning, toward me.
